description: Repairs r-expr-1/bind-parameter-lifecycle: the worker crashed in Requery(qd). Asks the same question without the argument form: a QueryDef dynaset is read with pl = 1, pl is set to 2 and it is read, Requery() with no argument is called and it is read, a second recordset is read; the SQL is replaced by a Text-parameter statement, Parameters are refreshed and read and a value is assigned and read; a saved QueryDef over One is read before and after ALTER TABLE adds a column (QueryDefs and Fields refreshed; SQL, Fields.Count and rows read). Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
